newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria to nearly double output at gas plant.
newsitem.headline: Syria to nearly double output at gas plant.

text.p: Syria is planning to increase production at its Gbeseh gas plant to around three million cubic metres per day (cm/pd) from 1.7 million cm/pd at the beginning of 1997 when the expansion operations will be finished.
Official sources said on Thursday that the gas, which is produced from nearby fields and processed in the plant, will be sent to the amonia uria fertiliser plant in the city of Homs in west Syria.
The gas will also run through the pipelines to the refinery of Homs.
The pipelines' capacity would also be increased to 2.5 million cm/pd from 1.5 million cm/pd to cover the need of the town of Zara in west Syria with clean gas.
Syria, which produces around 600,000 barrel of oil per day, is planning to increase its gas production capacity to 16.05 million cm/pd in 2000 from 8.05 million cm/pd produced in 1995.
